classification.difficultyReason: Source MASTERY, NAPLAN B+: derive the square side length and account for exposed half-side steps while excluding internal boundaries.

content.prompt: Penelope made a shape using 6 identical squares. What is the perimeter of the shape?

spec.description: Six unshaded identical squares arranged in centred rows of three, two and one, with each higher row inset by half a square on both sides. All internal boundaries and the 27 cm full-base dimension are retained.
spec.mathematics: Each square has side 9 cm. The exterior has six square-side lengths of horizontal boundary and six square-side lengths of vertical boundary.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 27 cm base dimension is visible.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\text{Square side}&=27\div3\\&=9\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$

The four horizontal steps are each half a square side. Add the outside horizontal and vertical lengths; internal boundaries do not count.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Horizontal total}&=27+9+4\times4.5\\&=54\text{ cm}\\\text{Vertical total}&=6\times9\\&=54\text{ cm}\\P&=54+54\\P&=108\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
